niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, polished interfaces that feel complete and easy to scan: light or balanced themes, strong but simple hierarchy, concise copy, clear grouping, and enough visible content to feel finished. They like prominent primary actions, clear navigation affordances, and screens that are populated rather than sparse. They generally dislike clutter, excessive nesting, overly dense layouts, and busy or alarmist presentation.

criteria.description: Prefers screens that feel fully populated, with enough visible settings, rows, or content to feel finished rather than sparse or placeholder-like.
Prefers a clear focal point with one dominant title, card, or primary section, instead of multiple competing blocks or equally weighted elements.
Prefers compact, focused layouts with fewer visible elements per screen and less vertical clutter.
Prefers content organized into clear grouped sections or categories, with logical separation and minimal fragmentation.
Prefers short, direct, concise copy over longer descriptive or verbose text.
Prefers the main next step or CTA to be obvious, prominent, and easy to act on.
Prefers interfaces that feel finished, refined, and app-like rather than prototype-like, utilitarian, or unfinished.
Prefers clear, standard navigation cues such as visible back/next controls, chevrons, and action-specific control types.
Prefers clean, unified card surfaces with clear boundaries and balanced spacing, avoiding fragmented nested cards or overly boxed panels.
Prefers a calm, friendly, reassuring presentation over a harsh, clinical, or alarmist tone.
